name: Dinka (Thuongjang)
notes: Dinka has several dialects (Bor, Padang, Rek, Agar, Ngok, Twic, Malual...); Google draft follows one standard. Reviewers should say which dialect they checked

name: Swahili
notes: Used in Equatoria and by returnees; not a first language for most counties

name: Arabic (Modern Standard)
notes: Modern Standard Arabic, the written standard. Classical (Quranic) Arabic is not used for public advisories

name: Juba Arabic (Latin letters)
notes: Lingua franca in Juba, Wau, Malakal and towns. No machine translation exists; translate by hand in a consistent Latin spelling

name: Shilluk (Dhøg Cøllø)
notes: Fashoda, Panyikang, Malakal. No machine translation

name: Acholi
notes: Magwi. Google draft used only if the Translation API lists Acholi; check dialect with a Magwi speaker

name: Bari
notes: Juba, Terekeka, Lainya area. No machine translation

name: Toposa
notes: Kapoeta East, North, South. No machine translation

name: Zande
notes: Western Equatoria (Yambio, Nzara, Ezo, Tambura...). No machine translation

name: Moru
notes: Mundri, Maridi area. No machine translation

name: Kakwa
notes: Yei, Morobo, Kajo-keji. No machine translation
